@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The government invited several marketing experts to devise a s______y to promote domestic tourist attractions.
= strategy
~詞義 strategy（n.）策略
~原文 The government invited several marketing experts to devise a strategy to promote domestic tourist attractions.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Edward's recent behavior has been really o______d. We don't understand why he is acting so strangely.
= odd
~詞義 odd（adj.）古怪的
~原文 Edward's recent behavior has been really odd. We don't understand why he is acting so strangely.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The woman p______ded that nothing had happened when she heard the bad news.
= pretended
~詞義 pretend（v.）假裝
~原文 The woman pretended that nothing had happened when she heard the bad news.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The problem of domestic ______ (violent) can't be solved by arrests and prosecutions alone.
= violence
~詞義 violence（n.）暴力
~原文 The problem of domestic violence can't be solved by arrests and prosecutions alone.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: If you ______ (multiple) 13 by 7, you get 91.
= multiply
~詞義 multiply（v.）乘以
~原文 If you multiply 13 by 7, you get 91.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Many students rely on their ______ phones not only for communication but also for studying and managing daily tasks.
A: sticky
B: bizarre
C: mobile
D: rational
= C
~詞義 mobile（adj.）可移動的;行動電話(mobile phone)
~原文 Many students rely on their mobile phones not only for communication but also for studying and managing daily tasks.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The mysterious ______ was alone, and no one knew where he had come from.
A: decoration
B: republic
C: county
D: traveler
= D
~詞義 traveler（n.）旅行者
~原文 The mysterious traveler was alone, and no one knew where he had come from.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: William likes to sing a soft and happy ______ to himself as he works in the garden.
A: stadium
B: van
C: tune
D: cruelty
= C
~詞義 tune（n.）曲調
~原文 William likes to sing a soft and happy tune to himself as he works in the garden.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It is not easy for a single mother to feed and ______ one child, let alone three.
A: clothe
B: wed
C: squeeze
D: pump
= A
~詞義 clothe（v.）給…穿衣
~原文 It is not easy for a single mother to feed and clothe one child, let alone three.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Before Christmas, volunteers ______ the whole campus to give it a holiday atmosphere.
A: broadcast
B: decorated
C: furnished
D: intended
= B
~詞義 decorate（v.）裝飾
~原文 Before Christmas, volunteers decorated the whole campus to give it a holiday atmosphere.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: cleaner
B: wedding
C: unreasonable
D: stare
E: photographer
F: caved

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The bride and groom only invited their best friends and relatives to the ______.
= B
~詞義 wedding（n.）婚禮
~原文 The bride and groom only invited their best friends and relatives to the wedding.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Demanding perfect results in every situation is a(n) ______ expectation that only adds stress.
= C
~詞義 unreasonable（adj.）不合理的
~原文 Demanding perfect results in every situation is a(n) unreasonable expectation that only adds stress.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Judy has no time to do house chores, so she wants to hire a(n) ______ to help her tidy the house.
= A
~詞義 cleaner（n.）清潔工
~原文 Judy has no time to do house chores, so she wants to hire a(n) cleaner to help her tidy the house.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: After the earthquake, the walls and ceilings of the shopping mall ______ in, and the shoppers were trapped inside until the rescue team arrived.
= F
~詞義 cave（v.）塌陷
~原文 After the earthquake, the walls and ceilings of the shopping mall caved in, and the shoppers were trapped inside until the rescue team arrived.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is not polite to ______ at a stranger for a long time.
= D
~詞義 stare（v.）盯
~原文 It is not polite to stare at a stranger for a long time.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: brutal
B: desires
C: motor
D: advance
E: professor
F: stick

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Customers who want to have a meal at this restaurant are advised to make reservations in ______.
= D
~詞義 advance（n.）事先
~原文 Customers who want to have a meal at this restaurant are advised to make reservations in advance.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: While most of his companions gave up, James decided to ______ to his goal and finally made his debut (初次登臺) in Seoul with four other new team members.
= F
~詞義 stick（v.）堅持
~原文 While most of his companions gave up, James decided to stick to his goal and finally made his debut (初次登臺) in Seoul with four other new team members.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is impossible for parents to constantly satisfy the ever-changing ______ of their children for new toys.
= B
~詞義 desire（n.）慾望
~原文 It is impossible for parents to constantly satisfy the ever-changing desires of their children for new toys.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Something must have gotten into the ______. That is why it isn't working properly.
= C
~詞義 motor（n.）馬達
~原文 Something must have gotten into the motor. That is why it isn't working properly.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ asked one student to summarize the main points of the lecture.
= E
~詞義 professor（n.）教授
~原文 The professor asked one student to summarize the main points of the lecture.
